0040fcf0.behavior: Compose the actual410f20 row skip before capturing drawing geometry. Capture doubled signedWORD width once; each row reloads signedWORD width and fullDWORD visible widthd3b544. Start at the current cursor plus captured2*width. Consume complete literal and transparent runs until signed remaining width is nonpositive. Copy a literal WORD only when signed(width-visibleWidth-decodedColumns)<=0.
0040fcf0.row_advance: Advance from the actual final leftward pixel cursor by the freshly loaded fullDWORD pitch. Oversized runs can therefore shift subsequent rows relative to the initial row base. Zero/negative width still applies the native cursor and pitch arithmetic for every positive-height row.

Use arithmetic right shift by1 for the clipping counter, including downward rounding of negative odd values. Start at preservedRowBase+captured2*width-clipBytes. Consume complete runs and copy a literal WORD only while signed(width-SAR(clipBytes,1)-decodedColumns)>0.
0040fdd0.row_advance: Preserve the original row base across decoding and advance that base by the freshly loaded fullDWORD pitch. The next row does not depend on the final leftward cursor.

shared_contracts.widths: Framebuffer e92e18, pitch e38d94, X d3b5e0, Y d3b5dc, row countd3b5d4 and both clipping fields are fullDWORD. Widthd3b5be is signedWORD. Tags/skip counts are unsignedBYTE and copied pixels are WORD.
shared_contracts.literal_consumption: Both clipped siblings consume every WORD of a literal run, including runs longer than remaining row width. This differs from the separately proved131 decoder's early literal stop. No new clamp is introduced.
shared_contracts.transparent_runs: Apply the entire skip to remaining width, clipping counter and leftward cursor. A skip can overshoot a row. Zero literal and zero skip commands retain original behavior.
shared_contracts.arithmetic: All address, stride and counter arithmetic wraps at32 bits. Native signed tests explicitly reinterpret those wrapped values. Odd clip-byte values may produce odd destination addresses, preserving x86 WORD access behavior.
shared_contracts.nonpositive_height: The row-skip helper is still called before testing drawing height. No destination WORD is written when the signed height is nonpositive.
shared_contracts.helper: Actual accepted src/unit_00149.c composes on both native and C sides. Its preserved high-EAX carry, full returned pointer and consumed source are tested here; no helper replacement or controlled drawing endpoint is used.
shared_contracts.EAX_and_stack: Both existing public C interfaces remain void. Native final EAX is the consumed source cursor; a compile-time test trace compares it as an additional internal observation. Native temporary byte stores in stack scratch/by-value argument slots are permitted; caller guards outside the argument are checked.
shared_contracts.registers: Native and both C variants preserve EBX/EBP/ESI/EDI and the cdecl stack. Incidental caller-saved register contents are not promoted to a C contract.

proof.memory: Complete524288-byte source and524288-byte framebuffer, full watched state and canaries participate in SHA comparison. Native writes outside framebuffer/stack are rejected; encoded source is read-only.
proof.ordered_pixels: Traced C compares the ordered WORD address/value digest and count, plus the exact final source cursor and actual helper entry/exit pointer/state observations.
proof.plain_variant: Separate aliases include each actual product body after explicitly undefining tracing. Each plain variant independently matches native full pixels/state/source/helper observations and ABI; the verifier asserts that it emitted no trace output.
proof.fixture_domains: Literal/transparent/zero commands; oversized literals and skips; signedWORD widths including0/negative and above255; fullDWORD geometry and clip values; clipping boundaries and negative odd SAR; positive/negative pitch;32-bit coordinate multiplication wrap; distinct source/frame offsets; long-literal helper carry; entry/exit helper mutations of geometry and clipping; repeated calls.
proof.private_build: Win32 /O2 /W4 with fixed base10000 and no dynamic base. Smoke1/1 exercises both siblings and both compiled variants.

frozen_dependencies: The accepted mirrored131/149 sources,1066 proof and old upper-raster suite files were not edited during this phase.
limitations: Mapped bounded source/frame fixtures; no arbitrary malformed-stream termination guarantee or entire-city pixel fidelity claim.
The native ABI requires a clear direction flag. Production bodies do not enable the test-only trace macro.
